overall_limitations: Several rubric entries are divided across claims without any individual claim adequately stating the complete entry, including PASSIVE, FULL, RESTART, and NORMAL durability.

The output omits busy-handler fallback, checkpoint-lock callback exclusion, detailed status-counter semantics, multi-database behavior, per-connection automatic configuration, hook replacement, and checkpoint-induced COMMIT latency.

S1's completion and reader-blocking statements require qualification against S2's busy fallback and reader-admission rules. Attribution makes f29 and f30 supported reports, but does not reconcile operational behavior.
Six listed concepts have no distinct supporting claims, and c2 duplicates the definition of c1.
